requirements.text: Enhance customer experience and ensure competitiveness with fintech challengers.
Deliver real-time push notifications for all transactions, including transaction amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Real-time notifications should be processed within five seconds of the transaction being authorised.
Implement biometric authentication using both fingerprint and facial recognition.
Allow users to apply for in-app lending and credit applications, including overdraft increases and personal loans.
Provide an intuitive interface for in-app lending and credit applications, guiding users through the application steps.
Provide clear information about requirements, documentation, and estimated approval timelines for lending applications.
Incorporate real-time feedback during the lending application process, such as alerts for customers nearing their credit limit.
Ensure transparency around interest rates, repayment amounts, and associated fees for lending options.
Comply with Central Bank regulations on responsible lending.
Integrate seamlessly with the existing core banking system without modifications to the mainframe.
Adhere to PSD2's Strong Customer Authentication requirements for payment initiations and sensitive account access.
Process and store all customer financial data within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months during the transition.
Deliver automated monthly spending breakdowns to help customers understand their financial habits.
Introduce budgeting tools that allow users to set personal spending limits and receive alerts for nearing or exceeding those limits.
Provide a unified view of all customer accounts on the home screen, including current, savings, and credit card balances.
